task.description:
Validate release readiness for SPT-02/03/04 unified batch. Check: (1) all SPT-02 MUST acceptance criteria are covered by passing tests in scratch/run-final.txt, (2) no BLOCKER/MAJOR issues in test output, (3) zig build bench exits 0 (NFR check). Write release decision to docs/status/release-spt-02-<date>.yaml.

Expected passing tests: spt01_provisioning, spt02_data_migration (TC-SPT-02-01..05), adp02 schema scope, adp03 context resolution, adp04 user binding, adp05 artifact hash, adp06 pipeline correlation, adp09 audit chain, adp10 agent capture, adp12 default tenant.

Note: zig build bench requires BPM_DB_URL (dev DB). Use: $env:BPM_DB_URL='postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5432/bpm_dev'; zig build bench 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 5
acceptance_criteria: All SPT-02 acceptance criteria (TC-SPT-02-01..05) have PASS test results
